title: Four-Worker Parallel Batch With the Existing Stack: Two Codex, Antigravity and Local Qwen Under One Main-Thread Orchestrator, Without a New Orchestrator Skill
target_platform: Claude Code orchestrator; Codex CLI x2, Antigravity CLI, local MLX Qwen2.5-Coder-7B; flight board, merge_prep, cli-agent, usage_hook
hypothesis: A single main-thread orchestrator (Claude) using only the existing stack (flight board, manage_coordination, cli-agent, merge_prep, usage_hook delegated, validate_missions) can run ONE bounded batch of four concurrent workers (Codex A, Codex B, Antigravity, local Qwen2.5-Coder-7B), each in its own leased worktree, such that: (a) the four runs overlap for at least 50% of the shortest worker's runtime; (b) there are 0 undeclared edits outside leased paths and 0 writes into a peer worktree; (c) at least 3 of 4 deliveries are accepted after cross-vendor review and the orchestrator's own re-run of the acceptance checks; (d) measured tokens are attributable per worker session for at least 3 of 4 workers; (e) accepted deliveries integrate onto a dedicated integration branch with at most 1 conflict round each after merge_prep regeneration and a green combined suite; and (f) review finds at least 1 real defect the author's self-assessment missed.
falsification_criteria: Any of: an undeclared edit, clobbered file or write into a peer worktree; fewer than 2 accepted deliveries; the workers were not concurrent (overlap under 50% of the shortest runtime); per-worker tokens attributable for fewer than 3 workers; an integration needing more than 1 conflict round despite merge_prep, or a red combined suite; a push, merge to main or publication without explicit human approval; the human-managed MLX server stopped or reconfigured; or review finds no defect in any of the four deliveries. This is NOT a test of MISSION-033's three-worker thresholds (60% wall-clock, 25% orchestrator overhead, 80% review agreement), and no speedup claim is valid without a measured baseline.
baseline_evidence: Flight board, impact verify and merge_prep are corroborated (026, 031, 034). Usage: exact per-task tokens work but the per-class predictor is falsified (035 at N=14), the Codex pair cannot be separated by the current recorder, and a Claude delegate shares the account window with its orchestrator. Local autonomy beyond a single hop was falsified (022); structured tool-calling works (021). The relay raised handover consistency 22.7% to 68.2% but missed its 90% bar (025). Lease fencing (038) is not implemented. Headroom when created: claude 43%, agy 11.4% constrained, codex 58%; the machine's swap was about 92% used with a human-managed MLX server resident. Orchestration and verification dominated delegation cost in earlier delegated tasks.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate the orchestrator only if integration needs a semantic judgement that the review pair cannot settle.

related_missions.MISSION-033: PARENT: this batch is the 'configuration alone' arm of 033's falsification criterion (no new orchestrator skill) with four workers instead of three; it does not test 033's thresholds.
related_missions.MISSION-026: DEPENDS ON: flight board, leases and isolated worktrees for four concurrent workers.
related_missions.MISSION-031: DEPENDS ON: declared impact, overlap detection and `verify` of actual edits per worker.
related_missions.MISSION-034: DEPENDS ON: merge_prep regeneration when integrating accepted deliveries.
related_missions.MISSION-035: DEPENDS ON: exact per-worker token records and headroom; the per-class predictor is falsified, so budgets are explicit caps.
related_missions.MISSION-025: READS: relay and handoff limits (68.2% consistency, below its 90% bar); handoffs are not assumed to transfer fully.
related_missions.MISSION-022: CONSTRAINED BY: broad local multi-turn autonomy was falsified, so Qwen gets narrow, checkable work only.
related_missions.MISSION-021: USES: the existing local structured-output and tool-call interface.
related_missions.MISSION-028: READS: proposed local-to-cloud escalation; its targets are not assumed achieved.
related_missions.MISSION-036: READS: proposed evidence contracts; keeps delivery and claim corroboration separate.
related_missions.MISSION-037: READS: proposed dependency-aware invalidation of inherited claims.
related_missions.MISSION-038: READS: proposed lease fencing and crash recovery; NOT implemented, so recovery is supervised.
related_missions.MISSION-045: FEEDS: per-model, per-worker evidence for complementary-collaborator selection.
related_missions.MISSION-051: FEEDS: same-bucket two-model usage data (Codex A vs B, agy vs Codex) for the size-bucket predictor and effort ratio.
related_missions.MISSION-053: FEEDS and RECIPROCAL: the failures and human interventions recorded in this mission's closeout.md are the evidence base for repairing the shared orchestrating-agent-work skill; started only after this mission and missions 004, 041 and 050 are closed.
related_missions.MISSION-054: FEEDS: MISSION-054 uses the orchestration failures, human interventions and telemetry gaps recorded in this mission's closeout as its evidence source.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-05 by claude-code. Deliberately narrow: the orchestrator holds no broad lease; each worker is leased on its own mission or exclusive artifact path, and the integration branch is a separate worktree.
